assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.text: So, Hamad, shall we continue working on our group presentation?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.zh: 那么，哈马德，我们继续做小组展示吧？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.text: Daniel and Samia are focusing on the environmental issues of fast fashion,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.zh: 丹尼尔和萨米娅正关注快时尚的环境问题，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.text: so we'll be talking about copyright infringement.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.zh: 所以我们将讨论侵犯版权的问题。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.text: Daniel said they've already written their part of the presentation, you know.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.zh: 丹尼尔说他们已经写好了展示的那一部分，你知道。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.text: We've only just got started on ours.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8d503c95792151f.zh: 我们才刚开始做自己的部分。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.text: we're focusing on the way that fast fashion companies lift unknown artists' designs and put them onto their products,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.zh: 我们关注的是快时尚公司如何挪用不知名艺术家的设计，并把它们印在自己的产品上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.text: which they then sell in huge numbers.
So, first, I think we should talk about what happened to Vanessa Bowman.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.zh: 首先，我们该谈谈瓦妮莎·鲍曼的遭遇。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.text: The artist from the south of England who paints the world around her?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.zh: 那位来自英格兰南部、描绘自己周围世界的艺术家？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_23c2c8db552857f.text: natural scenes, that sort of thing.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b3b496f69a068b1.text: A fast fashion company lifted images of her paintings they found on her website and used them on a clothing range.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b3b496f69a068b1.zh: 一家快时尚公司从她的网站上抄走她绘画作品的图像，并将其用于一个服装系列。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b3b496f69a068b1.text: I'm sure they made a lot of money, and I don't think she got anything in return.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_b3b496f69a068b1.zh: 我相信他们赚了很多钱，但我不认为她得到了任何回报。
也没有对她作品的署名，什么都没有。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_792b46f2b6f771a.text: We should also use the example of Kirsty Morin.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_792b46f2b6f771a.zh: 我们也应该举克丝蒂·莫林的例子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_792b46f2b6f771a.text: Her artwork was also used by a fast fashion company, and again, she got nothing from them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_792b46f2b6f771a.zh: 她的作品也被一家快时尚公司使用，而她同样什么都没得到。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_792b46f2b6f771a.text: I mean, this is a perfect example of a company taking an artist's designs without permission and using them to sell clothes and make a profit.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_792b46f2b6f771a.zh: 我是说，这完全是公司未经许可拿走艺术家的设计，再用来卖衣服赚钱的典型例子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_634afc3bd7dc561.text: Some large fashion companies take legal action when their designs are copied, but it takes money and power to do that.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_634afc3bd7dc561.zh: 一些大型时尚公司在设计被抄袭时会采取法律行动，但这么做需要资金和影响力。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_634afc3bd7dc561.text: It's just not practical for an independent artist like Kirsty Morin to say,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_634afc3bd7dc561.zh: 像克丝蒂·莫林这样的独立艺术家若说，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_634afc3bd7dc561.text: if you don't pay me for my hard work and talent, I'll be contacting my lawyer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_634afc3bd7dc561.zh: “如果你不为我的辛勤工作和才华付钱，我就会联系我的律师”，这并不现实。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.text: Well, I have seen some examples of artists defending their intellectual property, but not many.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.zh: 嗯，我见过一些艺术家捍卫自己知识产权的例子，但不多。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.text: I haven't read about her yet.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.zh: 我还没有读到过她的事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.text: She did do something about it after she discovered that a fast fashion company was converting her designs into images and putting them on clothing and bags.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.zh: 她发现一家快时尚公司把自己的设计转成图像，印在衣服和包上后，确实采取了行动。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.text: Elora decided it wasn't worth complaining to them by email,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.zh: 埃洛拉认为不值得通过电子邮件向他们投诉，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.text: so she tried a different approach.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_a33cedca1a34918.zh: 于是她尝试了另一种做法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.text: She posted her complaint on social media, and it went viral.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.zh: 她在社交媒体上发布了投诉，这件事迅速走红。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.text: Thousands of people from all over the world criticized the company and promised never to buy anything from them again.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.zh: 来自世界各地的数千人批评了这家公司，并承诺再也不买他们的任何东西。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.text: the company wrote to her offering an apology.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.zh: 公司最终写信给她道歉。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.text: They actually paid her something for using her work and promised it would never happen again.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_2b5cad23d8c085a.zh: 他们确实为使用她的作品付给她一些钱，并承诺这再也不会发生。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.text: That's one happy ending, at least.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.zh: 至少，这算是一个圆满结局。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.text: The same companies lifted her work several times since then and used it on all sorts of products.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.zh: 从那以后，同一家公司又多次挪用她的作品，用在各种产品上。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.text: Although they've accepted it was their fault again,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.zh: 虽然他们再次承认是自己的错，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.text: she still hasn't received a second payment.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.zh: 她仍然没有收到第二笔赔偿。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.text: She's going to be disappointed this time, I imagine.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_48e9745009aecd3.zh: 我想，她这次会感到失望。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4a1fd31eec1fe51.text: It's plagiarism, basically, and it's not ethical.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4a1fd31eec1fe51.zh: 说到底，这是剽窃，也是不道德的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4a1fd31eec1fe51.text: Imagine doing that sort of thing at our university.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4a1fd31eec1fe51.zh: 想象一下在我们的大学课程中做这种事！

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0aa9a92e2e1976e.text: The thing is, these companies do have the ability and the resources to collaborate with artists, pay them for their designs, and still make a lot of money, but they choose not to.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_0aa9a92e2e1976e.zh: 问题是，这些公司确实有能力和资源与艺术家合作，为设计付费，同时仍然赚很多钱，但他们选择不这么做。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6b6445593257f91.text: these companies will be ignoring copyright law just like they do now,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6b6445593257f91.zh: 这些公司仍会像现在一样无视版权法，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6b6445593257f91.text: and artists still won't be getting anything.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_6b6445593257f91.zh: 而艺术家仍然什么也得不到。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: She got the attention of the fashion world with her unique designs,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 她凭借独特的设计吸引了时尚界的关注，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: which combine traditional Muslim fashion with French chic.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 这些设计把传统穆斯林服饰与法式时尚结合起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Aisha, thank you for coming to the studio.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 艾莎，感谢你来到演播室。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Thank you for having me.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 谢谢你的邀请。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: First of all,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 首先，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: can you tell me where you get your ideas from?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 你能告诉我你的灵感来自哪里吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Well, I come from a Muslim family.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 嗯，我来自一个穆斯林家庭。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: My parents are both from Qatar.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我的父母都来自卡塔尔。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: I was born there but then we travelled a lot.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我在那里出生，但后来我们经常旅行。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: I went to school in New York and I went to a design school there.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我在纽约上学，也在那里读了设计学校。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: These days I spend my time travelling between Qatar and the United States.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 如今我往返于卡塔尔和美国之间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: How did you feel about growing up in New York?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 在纽约长大，你有什么感受？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Well, as a teenager in New York, I had a lot of problems trying to dress in a modest way.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 嗯，作为在纽约的青少年，我在尝试穿得端庄得体时遇到了许多困难。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: For example,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 例如，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: when you look at summer fashion in New York,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 当你看看纽约的夏季时尚时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: the trend is always to wear skirts,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 流行趋势总是穿裙子，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: shorts and sleeveless shirts.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 短裤和无袖衬衫。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: I didn't feel comfortable wearing them but at the same time,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我穿那些衣服觉得不自在，但同时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: my friends thought it was strange to wear long sleeves and jeans in the summer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我的朋友觉得夏天穿长袖和牛仔裤很奇怪。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: So I've always tried to combine my culture with fashion.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 所以我一直努力把自己的文化与时尚结合起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: As a teenager, I would make my own clothes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 十几岁时，我会自己做衣服，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: like colourful skirts and scarves.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 比如色彩鲜艳的裙子和头巾。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: I wanted my designs to be individual.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我希望我的设计具有个性。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: They were unique and eventually people admired my clothes rather than laughed at me.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 它们很独特，最终人们欣赏我的衣服，而不是嘲笑我。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: I see.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我明白了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: So do you know what ideas most people have about Muslim clothes?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 那么，你知道大多数人对穆斯林服装有什么看法吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: I think there's a lot of misunderstanding about Muslim clothes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我认为人们对穆斯林服装有很多误解。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: The thing is that when you say Muslim fashion,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 问题是，当你说起穆斯林时尚时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: people in New York think of a burqa, you know, like the blue or black cloaks which cover women from head to toe.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 纽约人会想到布卡罩袍，你知道，就是那种从头到脚遮住女性身体的蓝色或黑色长袍。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: And could you explain what you think Muslim fashion is?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 你能解释一下你认为的穆斯林时尚是什么吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Let me give you an example.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 让我举个例子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: When I first started at design school,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我刚开始上设计学校时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: my teachers would ask me strange questions such as how I was going to stay in the fashion business if I'm not going to design miniskirts or sleeveless shirts.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我刚进设计学校时，老师会问我一些奇怪的问题，比如如果我不设计迷你裙或无袖上衣，怎样在时尚行业立足。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: But as far as I'm concerned,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 但就我而言，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: there is much more to fashion than showing your body.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 时尚的意义远不只是展示身体。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: There are millions of Muslim women who live in the United States and Europe who want to wear fashionable clothes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 数百万住在美国和欧洲的穆斯林女性想穿时髦衣服。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: There are also women who simply like to dress in a modest way.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 也有些女性只是喜欢穿得端庄。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: So are you saying that there is a need for fashionable clothes for Muslim women?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 所以你的意思是，穆斯林女性有对时尚服装的需求吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: Absolutely.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 当然。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.text: We want to be fashionable and be ourselves at the same time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_95822e78fb76ba9.zh: 我们既想时尚，也想做自己。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: So I've always tried to combine my culture with fashion.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 所以我一直努力把自己的文化与时尚结合起来。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: As a teenager, I would make my own clothes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 十几岁时，我会自己做衣服，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: like colourful skirts and scarves.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 比如色彩鲜艳的裙子和头巾。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: I wanted my designs to be individual.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我希望我的设计具有个性。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: They were unique and eventually people admired my clothes rather than laughed at me.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 它们很独特，最终人们欣赏我的衣服，而不是嘲笑我。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我明白了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: So are you saying that there is a need for fashionable clothes for Muslim women?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 所以你的意思是，穆斯林女性有对时尚服装的需求吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: Absolutely.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 当然。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: We want to be fashionable and be ourselves at the same time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我们既想时尚，也想做自己。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: My feeling is this.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我的想法是这样的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: I want to create clothes which are modest but at the same time give women confidence,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我想设计既端庄又能让女性自信的服装，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: clothes which allow women to be themselves.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 让女性能够做自己的服装。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: I see what you mean.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我明白你的意思。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: So how would you describe your style?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 那么你会如何描述自己的风格？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: Well,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 嗯，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: many reviewers have described my style as traditional chic and I guess I'd agree with them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 许多评论家把我的风格称为“传统时髦”，我想我同意这种说法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: What I think is that combining traditional with chic is a huge area in fashion.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我认为，传统与时髦结合是时尚中的一大领域。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: I keep my eye on the fashion trends in other countries.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 我关注其他国家的时尚潮流。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: When you look at the works of other designers in China and India, you can see that many traditional styles are being reused by young designers.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 当你看中国和印度其他设计师的作品时，会发现许多传统风格正被年轻设计师重新使用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: Above all,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 最重要的是，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: people like to be individuals and show their cultural roots.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 人们喜欢展现个性和自己的文化根源。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: They like to show where they come from.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 他们喜欢展示自己来自哪里。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: As I understand it,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 据我了解，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: your designs are must -haves for Muslim women outside the United States as well.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 你的设计对美国以外的穆斯林女性来说也是必备品。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.text: Could you tell me more about that?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_1cd7fdebd4411af.zh: 你能再多告诉我一些吗？
